description: The Government of Canada data portal publishes bias-adjusted and downscaled humidex projections from a 19-member CMIP6 ensemble. The describing article reports humidex itself and annual counts of days exceeding thresholds of 30, 35 and 40 for climate-change preparedness. The provider lists self-describing NetCDF4 files under the Open Government Licence - Canada with free public access. National gridded coverage can support heat-exposure scenarios for healthcare capacity, cooling demand and vulnerable built assets. The fields are model projections, not measured future temperatures or direct illness counts. Differences among climate models, emissions paths and the ERA5-Land bias-correction reference should be retained, not collapsed into one deterministic result. The exact grid interval and scenario years must be read from the selected NetCDF metadata before use; they were not checked by downloading files here. The product complements data-global-uhi-heatwave-exposure-2003-2020, which describes observed historical exposure, not future Canadian humidex.
